meta_description: From generative design in London to hand-finishing in Istanbul — how Silver & Elegant builds each piece, distributes selectively, and grows deliberately.

sections.label: Distribution
sections.title: Curated Global Retailers
sections.body:
Selective by Design

  

To preserve exclusivity and reduce waste, we work only with retail partners who share our commitment to considered, slow fashion. Our collections are available through Wolf & Badger, More4id, and Not Just A Label. We do not operate mass distribution channels — choosing instead to reach collectors who value permanent wearable art over seasonal consumption.
